items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, he had a little band. So did Wade.

ctx.x: When you went to San Francisco, was the Barbary Coast still operating and all of that kind of stuff, or...
No, no it wasn't, unh-uh. Not in '26. It might have been, but I didn't know anything about it. During that time, Clem Raymond was around there, a clarinet player, Wade Whaley...
In Los Angeles or San Francisco?
